mechanism: Chain several visually distinct local hazards along one continuous escape direction, let the subject repeatedly recover, grant one brief apparent safety upgrade, then reveal a single environmental-scale threat that dwarfs both subject and escape platform.

invariants.rule: Establish one subject and one persistent escape direction before the hazard chain.
invariants.purpose: Binds separate dangers into one route.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated directions make the sequence feel like a montage.

invariants.rule: Use at least two materially different local hazards with visible recoveries between them.
invariants.purpose: Builds escalation through changing physical duties.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated copies of one obstacle create no meaningful progression.

invariants.rule: Keep the same subject and route logic traceable through every recovery.
invariants.ablation_failure: Subject or geography resets break the causal chain.

invariants.rule: Provide one brief apparent safety upgrade or open platform late in the sequence.
invariants.purpose: Creates a readable baseline for the final reversal of scale.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without temporary relief, the ending is merely another hazard.

invariants.rule: Use one terminal scale reveal to reclassify the apparent safety state without inventing survival beyond the visible ending.
invariants.purpose: Makes the final threat change the meaning of all prior escapes.
invariants.ablation_failure: Claiming an unseen outcome overstates the evidence and weakens the hold.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
